description: Common structure every ENC-0a encoder-decision fixture validates against. `kind` names the decision branch exercised; `bench_input` is the JSONL row that feeds the resolver (null for the degraded baseline); `expected_decision` pins the full EncoderBackendDecisionV1 the resolver must emit (null when the branch is expected to error); `expected_outcome` is ok or error.
title: ENC-0a encoder-decision fixture envelope
